lessons.rule: Presence is not proof of integrity, identity or live analysis.

lessons.failure: Two files claim the same evidence gate
lessons.rule: Reject ambiguous or duplicate gate mappings.

lessons.failure: Hash matches manifest but differs from supplied original bytes
lessons.rule: Reject; the claimed file and independently supplied evidence must be byte-bound.

lessons.failure: Claimed capture ID differs from signed receipt or handoff
Anchor signer is also analysis or capture signer
lessons.rule: Reject role-key reuse even when all signatures verify.

lessons.failure: Independently pinned registry does not include the signed capture
lessons.rule: Hold; local registry rows are not proof of inclusion.

lessons.failure: HTTP 200 response contains only an empty message
lessons.rule: Treat result extraction as incomplete, never a numeric result.
Do not promote to live execution, E7 acceptance or deployed status.

lessons.failure: Sensitive request bytes or file paths are used in a failure message
lessons.rule: Return fixed reason codes only; do not echo payload, secrets or paths.

lessons.failure: File changes between hash inventory and later consumption
lessons.rule: Offline checks do not eliminate race or prove transmitted bytes; require hardened capture and external witness.
